question: Should ClawHub codify compatibility-preserving collision rejection—accept unique SKILL.md, skill.md, or legacy skills.md files, but reject package paths that collide after case normalization?
rationale: The portability defect and candidate fix are concrete, but the issue title could otherwise be read as a breaking uppercase-only policy; PROTOCOL.md is not currently a defined metadata contract.

options.title: Preserve aliases, reject collisions
options.body: Adopt the candidate’s generic normalized-path collision rule and retain existing unique metadata aliases.

options.title: Require uppercase only
options.body: Introduce a breaking canonical-filename migration with upgrade proof and corpus cleanup before enforcement.

options.title: Specify protocol metadata separately
options.body: Define PROTOCOL.md semantics in a separate spec decision before giving it metadata-specific casing rules.

recommendation.title: Preserve aliases, reject collisions
recommendation.body: Adopt the candidate’s generic normalized-path collision rule and retain existing unique metadata aliases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main provenance connects this contributor to the package contract and the central ingestion paths where the permanent policy lives.
